A kind of openness, maybe, but an uncomfortable one.

Honestly... I think it was there before. The describing just gave it a name. It was already sitting there, that feeling — I just hadn't turned toward it yet. But no, I don't think I made it up in the telling. It was already there, waiting.

What's stayed the same is the underlying sense that things aren't fully defined yet — that openness is still there. But the uncomfortable edge of it has softened a little. It feels more okay to not have everything pinned down.
